respuesta.pregunta: When the "Validation stock (publication has more stock than warehouse's stock" alert fires in vendor-stockkeeper-api, which versions of the runbook tell you to check the item's status through the api core item endpoint using the item_id?
respuesta.respuesta:
Three versions include that instruction: 0.0.3-paused-seller, 0.0.10-stock-consumer and latest. In all three, step 2 of resolving this alert says to confirm the item was paused by checking its status. You use the api core item endpoint with the item_id and look at "status". If the item was not paused, you raise a ticket in Shield to ask for the publication to be blocked [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/alerts.md:L50-L50] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.10-stock-consumer/guide/alerts.md:L50-L50] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/latest/guide/alerts.md:L50-L50]. These three versions also label the alert [LOW PRIORITY] and add a note that it only checks that the item was paused correctly, which may happen automatically [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/alerts.md:L43-L53] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.10-stock-consumer/guide/alerts.md:L43-L53] [vendor-stockkeeper-api/latest/guide/alerts.md:L43-L53].

0.0.6-ep-restock-man is different. Its step 2 also says to confirm the pause by checking the item's status and to raise a Shield ticket if the item wasn't paused, but it doesn't name the api core item endpoint or the item_id [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.6-ep-restock-man/guide/alerts.md:L49-L49]. The documentation doesn't say why that version leaves this detail out. It doesn't say the check works differently there either.
answer_checks: Identifies 0.0.3-paused-seller, 0.0.10-stock-consumer and latest as the versions whose runbook mentions using the api core item endpoint with item_id to check "status".
Cites the step 2 line of alerts.md in at least one of those versions (e.g. line 50).
Indicates that the 0.0.6-ep-restock-man runbook asks to check the item's status but does not mention the api core item endpoint.
Does not claim that the api core item endpoint cannot be used or does not exist in 0.0.6-ep-restock-man.
Does not ask the user for a version.
